The '''Griffyn/Y2TG hyperdrive''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] unit produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. A modified Class 0.75 Griffyn/Y2TG was used on [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar's]] [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]], the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']].<ref name="EGVV" />
